label: Microsoft Marketplace consulting services
terms_note: Requires a Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account + Partner Center; offers published in the UI; leads via Referrals API.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Partner Center Referrals API for leads; offers are UI-published). Lane `human` → **keep**. Confidence high.
auth: 1. Partner Center account → Azure AD app → delegated token.

endpoints.notes: Referral: ID, EngagementID, Name, ExternalReferenceID, Status, Solution Areas

reference.limits: - Partner Program membership; listing-only consulting offers; seller ID US/UK/CA. - Requires a Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account + Partner Center; offers published in the UI; leads via Referrals API.

reason: Consulting-service offers are published in the Partner Center UI and their customer leads are pushed to the partner's lead destination (CRM/HTTPS endpoint); the Partner Center Referrals API (GET https://api.partner.microsoft.com/v1.0/engagements/referrals, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/partner-center/developer/get-a-list-of-referrals, opened 2026-09-25) states 'Leads received from Microsoft Marketplace aren't supported' and covers co-sell referrals only, for Partner Center users holding Referrals Admin/User roles with an App+User (Entra ID) token. No API reaches the marketplace consulting leads, and the co-sell API is restricted to enrolled partners.
